answer: Require every agent to register through one credential-bound reef: one credential anchors the identity, and splitting it across a second identity slashes 100% of a 450-token bond locked for 75 days. The bond sits in a vault anyone can audit in seconds, so a fake cannot hide behind a fresh name. Each island of identities sharing one funding source is tallied together; on the third duplicate the cluster freezes and all its bonds are forfeited. A delta in payout follows: frozen identities earn nothing until auditors clear them. Creating 1,000 fakes costs 450,000 tokens locked.
